metaDescription: Every OrangenBot command: what it does, how to use it, and which permission it needs.
title: Every command in one place
lead: All {count} commands from version {version}: what they do, which options they take, and who can use them. Click a command for details.

how.slashText: Type / in Discord, start typing the name and pick it from the list. Discord asks for each option in its own field.
how.menuText: Right-click a member or a message (long-press on mobile), open Apps and pick the menu item.
how.everywhereText: Commands marked Anywhere also work when you add the bot to your own account: in DMs and on other servers.
how.permsText: Levels are only defaults: a server admin can tighten or loosen any of them with /permissions or on the dashboard.

legend.title: Legend
legend.levels: Levels build on each other: anything Staff can use, Moderators and Administrators can use too. The server owner and Discord administrators can use everything.

searchPlaceholder: Search by name, description or category (e.g. ban, music, stocks)
resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}} out of {total} commands
noResultsText: Try a shorter or different term, or clear the filters.
menuHow: This is not a typed command: it is a right-click menu item (long-press on mobile) under Apps.
everywhereText: Works anywhere: add the bot to your own account to use it in DMs and on other servers too.

access.everyoneText: Any member of the server can use it, no extra permission needed.
access.useCapability: A server admin can restrict it through this permission: {capability}.
access.levelText: By default members at {level} level can use it, and everyone above: {higher}.
access.levelTextTop: By default members at {level} level can use it.
access.discordAlt: Anyone with the Discord permission “{perm}” can also use it regardless of level (if accepting Discord permissions is turned on for the server).
access.configurable: A server admin can change this with /permissions or on the Permissions page of the dashboard.
access.discordText: By default only available with this Discord permission: {perms}. You can change it in Discord under Server Settings, Integrations, OrangenBot.
access.specialText: Special access: granted by the bot operators, cannot be changed per server.

ctaTitle: You decide who can use what
ctaText: On the dashboard you can tie every command permission to levels or roles.
